clauses.reason: Terminated by Executive Order 9894, signed September 23, 1947, which orders that the San Clemente Island Naval Defensive Sea Area, established by Executive Order 7747 as amended by Executive Orders 8536 and 9787, be and is hereby discontinued. It states no delayed effective date, so the effective date is the signing date, 1947-09-23 (the order was published September 25, 1947, the alternative reading). Executive Order 9787 restated Executive Order 7747 to read as follows: it established the defensive sea area, barred vessels from navigating within it except as authorized by the Secretary of the Navy, and set the penalties provided by law for violations. All three provisions depend on the existence of the area and ended when the area was discontinued.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (11 FR 11556) is Executive Order 9787 amending Executive Order 7747, with its heading, recital and the quoted restated order read in full. Inventory read and confirmed: one clause, the amending lead-in and the restated order (area, navigation bar, penalty), all of which fall with the area. End: Executive Order 9894 (12 FR 6353) discontinues the area by name, citing Executive Order 9787 among the orders that established it. The packet lacks an acting-provision record for Executive Order 9894, so the ending source cited is its full held text. Prior research: none reported. Searches: current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog, all complete with no coverage warning. The six own-term records in the dossier come from neighboring orders printed on the same page (a Civil Aeronautics Board notice and a claims regulation) and are not terms of this order.
